body: Scoring weights are basis points chosen so the accept bars compose meaningfully: positional evidence maxes at 7000, each 3-line context window adds 1500. With ACCEPT_BP=6000, a full positional match passes with zero context (k>=3), while a sub-majority match (e.g. 4/9 lines = 3111) passes ONLY when both contexts agree exactly (3111+3000=6111) — six exact surrounding lines is strong placement evidence. ACCEPT_BP_SHORT=8000 exceeds the 7000 positional max, so 1- and 2-line anchors can never re-match on content alone; they require at least one exact context window. This is the guard against low-entropy anchors (lone braces, blank lines) drifting to any identical line. All arithmetic stays in integers for cross-platform determinism; f32 confidence exists only at the reporting boundary.

The alignment model allows exactly ONE contiguous internal gap of |d|<=2 lines (prefix before the split + suffix after it). Two SEPARATE single-line insertions inside an anchor cannot both be captured: the best single split absorbs one, the lines beyond the second misalign, and the match count drops — often below the accept bar, orphaning an anchor whose content is fully present. This failure direction is deliberate (orphan rather than mis-anchor) but surprises people expecting diff-like tolerance. A multi-gap model is a v2 item; do not 'fix' this by widening MAX_INTERNAL_DRIFT, which multiplies false-positive surface instead.
